answer: Pearl divers guard the reef. Step one: each new identity posts a 2,000 POA dive bond. Step two: the diver descends three layers over 72 sequential hours — surface, cavern, trench — completing one proof-of-work attestation per layer; a missed layer cracks the shale, slashing half the bond and restarting the dive. Step three: random karst-cave audits re-verify 5% of divers each epoch, and fakes forfeit. Forging 1,000 identities locks 2,000,000 POA and burns 72,000 diver-hours of unparallelizable descent. Like pearl divers risking the bends for one real pearl, only the patient surface.
